Based on the visual symmetry of the image:

1.  **Identify the Lines**: The image displays a square with four kangaroos arranged in quadrants. There are four lines passing through the center:
    *   A vertical line.
    *   A horizontal line.
    *   A red diagonal line (bottom-left to top-right).
    *   A blue diagonal line (top-left to bottom-right).

2.  **Analyze Symmetry**:
    *   The kangaroos in the top-left and top-right are **mirror images** of each other. Folding along the **vertical line** brings them together perfectly.
    *   The kangaroos in the top-left and bottom-left are **mirror images** of each other. Folding along the **horizontal line** brings them together perfectly.
    *   The kangaroos in the bottom-left and top-right are **180-degree rotations** of each other. They are not mirror images, so folding along the red diagonal will not make them overlap exactly (their heads would not align).
    *   Similarly, the top-left and bottom-right kangaroos are 180-degree rotations of each other, so folding along the blue diagonal will not make them overlap exactly.

Therefore, the kangaroos can overlap exactly only along the horizontal and vertical lines.
